quotes.text: 28. ¿Cuántos días a la semana trabaja regularmente en su ocupación?
quotes.document: [C] CUESTIONARIO V9_bol_partir del cuarto trimestre de 2024.pdf

quotes.text: 29. ¿Cuántas horas en promedio trabaja al día en su ocupación?
quotes.document: [C] CUESTIONARIO V9_bol_partir del cuarto trimestre de 2024.pdf

assessments.reasoning: The questionnaire records time devoted to a person's employment or main occupation (days per week and hours per day) in Section 2, Questions 28 and 29. However, it does not include a time-use section or questions to record time allocated to unpaid domestic or care work, leisure, or self-care. According to the indicator instructions, if the instrument only records hours of paid work with no time recorded for any other daily activity, all four statements are false. Therefore, each element is set to false.
